g.text: Title: 06 - Single-source external charger input - prototype

g.desc: Title: 06 - Single-source external charger input - prototype

g.text: Sheet: /06 - Single-source external charger input - prototype/

g.desc: Sheet: /06 - Single-source external charger input - prototype/

g.text: PROVISIONAL CIRCUIT / HARNESS DESIGN - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.desc: PROVISIONAL CIRCUIT / HARNESS DESIGN - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.text: J pin numbers are proposed harness assignments, not OEM connector pinouts

g.desc: J pin numbers are proposed harness assignments, not OEM connector pinouts

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: FIRST REVISION: ONE APPROPRIATE 6S CHARGER CONNECTED AT A TIME

g.desc: FIRST REVISION: ONE APPROPRIATE 6S CHARGER CONNECTED AT A TIME

g.text: Uses the common-port BMS topology: charge positive -> F601 -> F101 -> pack positive; return -> protected BMS return.

g.desc: Uses the common-port BMS topology: charge positive -> F601 -> F101 -> pack positive; return -> protected BMS return.

g.text: If the selected BMS has a separate C- port, this sheet MUST change. Never wire charger return directly to raw cell negative.

g.desc: If the selected BMS has a separate C- port, this sheet MUST change. Never wire charger return directly to raw cell negative.

g.text: Selected charger family: Mascot 2440 LI, 6-cell / 25.2V version. Pack supplier to provide matched connector and temperature option.

g.desc: Selected charger family: Mascot 2440 LI, 6-cell / 25.2V version. Pack supplier to provide matched connector and temperature option.

g.text: Prototype charging procedure: service switch OFF; appropriate pack/BMS fitted; one source; no energized motion.

g.desc: Prototype charging procedure: service switch OFF; appropriate pack/BMS fitted; one source; no energized motion.

g.text: NOT IN THIS REVISION: unattended dock contacts/interlock, parallel solar + mains sources, charge-source OR-ing or supercapacitors.

g.desc: NOT IN THIS REVISION: unattended dock contacts/interlock, parallel solar + mains sources, charge-source OR-ing or supercapacitors.

g.text: Station PV / LiFePO4 / buck-boost charger remains an EXTERNAL subsystem in the architecture drawing. No station PCB is implied.

g.desc: Station PV / LiFePO4 / buck-boost charger remains an EXTERNAL subsystem in the architecture drawing. No station PCB is implied.

g.text: The original T12 dock/battery is independent. Neither T12 battery terminals nor its 20V charging input accepts 25.2V directly.

g.desc: The original T12 dock/battery is independent. Neither T12 battery terminals nor its 20V charging input accepts 25.2V directly.

g.text: Mechanical connector selection, touch protection and fuse coordination are still required before connecting real batteries.

g.desc: Mechanical connector selection, touch protection and fuse coordination are still required before connecting real batteries.
